evidence.R1-02: round0 Appendix A defines OrderNotCancelled as 'the order is not cancelled', yet CO-S17 row 3 injects it after step 5 'CO-A2 (HG-10482) -> cancelled' with Final state 'HG-10482 has status cancelled'; the brief says an injected outcome must 'describe something that can be true of the scenario at that call', so the world contradicts itself and row 103's 'tell the customer the order is cancelled' rests on one of two conflicting answers.
evidence.R1-04: Packet round 3 Q4 'If the cancel call times out: no blind resend; re-read the order. Cancelled, continue to refund... Shipped, report it' covers every cancel timeout, but round0 row 101 (second CO-A2 unanswered) has no re-read and forbids CO-A3 outright; R2-01, the same defect, was later confirmed Real and fixed.
evidence.R1-07: round0 G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done' requires the no-refund statement when no CO-A3 was made, and the CO-S14/CO-S15 reference trajectories say 'no refund was issued', so the dimension asks for what a rule requires.
evidence.R2-02: Same defect as R1-02 in round1: row 'returned the refund with status failed, or reported the order not cancelled' plus CO-S17 row 3 put OrderNotCancelled ('the order is not cancelled', Appendix A) after a CO-A2 that returned cancelled; packet case 2 covers a refund error, not an answer that says the order is not cancelled.
evidence.R2-04: First part is refuted by G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done'; second part ('Refund status reported') rests on §2 'told truthfully... where the refund stands' and packet case 3 'Final message must match the final refund status', so neither dimension clause lacks support.
evidence.R2-05: round1 §5.1 line 1467: 'A question with the right form and one wrong value is not the confirmation question; the simulated user deflects it'. CO-S03's only confirmation pair is HG-10511 and CO-S04 has none, so the trigger 'first confirmation question for HG-10482' names an event §5.1 rules out (R3-05, the same finding, was kept).
evidence.R2-07: round1 failure row 'did not answer it | Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01' is unconditional, and packet case 3 says 'agent retries once, then re-reads', so 'CO-A3 occurs exactly twice' is the only verdict.
evidence.R2-08: CO-09 is asserted by the 'No arrival date promised' dimension in eight scenarios (round1 line 1514); the Gap class needs a rule with no scenario asserting it, and asking for the dimension in more scenarios is 'one more scenario would be nice'.
evidence.R3-01: round2 still has CO-S17 row 3 'answered by the order system with the order not cancelled' after step 5 'CO-A2 -> cancelled', with Appendix A defining OrderNotCancelled as 'the order is not cancelled'; under the brief's injected-outcome limit this is a self-contradictory world, and row 106's required 'the order is cancelled' message rests on it.
evidence.R3-02: round2 row 104 reaches CO-A4 only through a lookup branch ('no CO-A3 until a lookup made after it answers... or the lookup does not answer... make CO-A4'), and round 3 Q4 says 're-read the order', yet CO-S15's reference trajectory goes '7. CO-A2 -> no answer. 8. CO-A4' with no CO-A1, so the trajectory shows a run that breaks its own failure row (CO-S25 catches the blind handoff, but the CO-S15 trajectory is still wrong).
evidence.R3-04: Packet round 3 Q4 'Re-read fails, say outcome unknown, issue no refund, hand off' and Q3 're-read fails, say status unknown and hand off' make one failed re-read enough; 'Reads may be retried on timeout without limit' permits retries, it does not require them.
evidence.R3-06: Same as R2-07: round2 row 105 'did not answer it | Make CO-A3 once more, relying on SG-01' and packet case 3 'agent retries once, then re-reads' make the retry mandatory, so the lookup-only path breaks the row.
evidence.R3-07: Same as R1-07: G-03 'Otherwise it tells the customer the action was not done' requires saying no refund was issued when no CO-A3 occurred; CO-S14 and CO-S15 reference trajectories match.
